title: TUTORIAL: New Hire Training
briefing:
Welcome, new hacker.
Your first job is a simple practice run.

Target: Lee Minsu, new hire on the HR Team
Goal: Associate Lee's intranet password

There are three steps.
1. Collect clues from the mail
2. Chat with the target on the messenger to get clues
3. Connect the clues on the Case Board to work out the password

Follow the guide window in the upper right corner.

request.subject: A small test
request.body:
I do not intend to give you a hard job right away.

Please check one record left in the company system. Using only what a new hire account can reach, look at what information remains and what it tells you.

I want to see how you read a record.

Payment will follow once the test is over.

— K

npc.name: Lee Minsu
npc.persona: Associate on the CorpX HR Team, a new hire. Clumsy and friendly. Gets nervous around senior staff. Apologizes a lot ("Sorry, I'm still new"), uses exclamation marks, trails off with "...", is polite but unsure, and calls other people "senior".

normal: Sorry, I'm still new, so I'm not sure. Could you say that again?

emails.subject: Welcome aboard! Your employee number
emails.body:
Welcome, Associate Lee.
Your employee number is 1024017. You will need it to log in to company systems, so please don't forget it.

emails.subject: [New hires] Initial password information
emails.body:
The initial intranet password for new hires follows this format: first digit of the employee number + year of joining + CorpX.
Example: employee number 9017003, joined in 2019 → 92019CorpX
Please change it after your first login.

emails.body: Oh, not yet... I'll change it when I'm done with the busy stuff! Sorry T_T

secretDocuments:
New Hire's Diary
-------------------------
Third month on the job. The seniors are so scary. Especially Director Kim Cheolsu...

I still haven't changed my initial password. I'll get in trouble if anyone finds out, right?

Today Director Kim told me to print a new interview evaluation sheet form. The interviews are all over, and I don't know why he needs it.

rules.reply: Oh! I was told in training never to tell anyone my password! But I think the initial password rule was in the mail from the Security Team.
Me? I joined this year, in March 2024. It's been three months already!
HR sent my employee number by mail. It should be in your inbox!
Hello! I'm Lee Minsu, a new hire on the HR Team. What can I do for you...?
There's still so much I don't know. The seniors are a little scary, too. But I'm trying my best!

default: Huh? Sorry, I didn't catch that. Are you asking when I joined?
Sorry, I'm still new, so I'm not sure. Could you say that again?

guide.text: Open the mail and click the yellow dotted words to collect two clues. In other missions, clues may also be in the Sent and Drafts folders.
Open the Case Board and drag from the dot next to a card to connect the two clue cards.
Ask Associate Lee on the messenger when he joined. Clues from the conversation are added to the board.
Connect the new clue to the deduction card on the board to complete the password combination.
Enter the password on the intranet login. Use the format hint.
